internalReferences.note: generate-sitemaps.js's IGNORE_DIRS does not include 'templates' or 'programmatic/templates' — it walks into programmatic/ (not ignored) and then templates/ (not ignored), picking up all 3 files as ordinary content pages. Five OTHER unrelated tools (page-population/link-validation scripts) already independently exclude 'programmatic/templates' from their own enumeration, confirming this exclusion is a known, established pattern elsewhere in the codebase that the sitemap generator alone lacks.

rootCause: R6 (multiple root causes): R3 (all 3 templates are publicly crawlable and indexable in their current, broken, unsubstituted form — real production defect, not merely theoretical) directly caused by R4 (scripts/generate-sitemaps.js's filesystem walk does not exclude the templates/ directory, so all 3 files were enumerated into sitemap-medium.xml and indexing-feed.xml, actively publishing them to crawlers) combined with the site's general no-build-exclusion Cloudflare Pages deployment model (every repository file is served verbatim; there is no build-output directory that could have kept programmatic/templates/ out of the deployed tree). This is not a deployment 'mistake' specific to this case (R5) since it is the same architecture used correctly for the rest of the static site — it is the interaction of that general architecture with the sitemap generator's missing exclusion and the absence of any other gate (no robots.txt disallow, no page-level noindex) that makes this a real, live defect rather than a harmless repository artifact.
productionImpact: Confirmed real: https://globalsizechart.com/programmatic/templates/{category,conversion,region}-template(.html) all return HTTP 200 (after Cloudflare's universal, unrelated .html-extension-stripping 308) with raw, unsubstituted {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens visible in the canonical tag, meta description, keywords, title, and body content, and an explicit <meta name="robots" content="index, follow"> directive. All 3 URLs are listed in 2 of the site's 4 sitemap files (sitemap-medium.xml, indexing-feed.xml), which are actively submitted for crawling. robots.txt has a blanket Allow: / for all crawlers including Googlebot, Bingbot, and several AI crawlers, with no disallow rule for /programmatic/ or /programmatic/templates/. All 3 URLs showed cf-cache-status: HIT on first test in this audit, indicating at least one prior fetch already occurred (not a first-touch MISS) - this does not by itself prove indexation, and no direct evidence of indexation in search results was found, but the absence-from-search-results is disclosed as supporting evidence only, not proof of non-indexation, per this phase's explicit instruction not to overclaim.
recommendedRemediation: Combination of Option A (guarantee the templates directory can never enter deployed/crawlable output) and Option C (explicitly exclude programmatic/templates from sitemap generation), applied asymmetrically per file: conversion-template.html is a live, actively-used generator input (scripts/generate-programmatic-pages.js, scripts/generate-pages.js) and must not be deleted or moved without updating both scripts' TEMPLATES_DIR-relative reference; category-template.html and region-template.html have zero current generator dependents and can be handled with fewer constraints. See Part 19/20 of the audit report for the deterministic Phase 10B implementation spec.
